**Issue-267 SDD artifacts rewritten against real tree — ground truth for context synthesizer**

**What**: Rewrote the four SDD artifacts for #267 (Intelligent Context Synthesizer) in English against the real `feature/v2.0.0`-based tree, replacing stale Spanish drafts written against `origin/main`.

**Why**: Prior drafts asserted things false on the real tree (records vs chunks, hardcoded origin/main, brain/core ignored, no failsafe).

**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-267/{proposal,spec,design,tasks}.md

**Learned** (ground truth that changed the plan):
- Memory records have NO `title` field. Schema is `id, ts, actor, actorKind, type, project, content` + optional `issue, supersedes, source`. `buildRecord()` (memory/lib/format.mjs:99) FOLDS title into content as `**title**\n\n…`. Reading `record.title` yields undefined.
- `.memory/index.jsonl` entries are `{id, ts, actor, type, project, file}` — NO `content`. It is a locator, NOT a keyword-query surface. Must read records/*.jsonl for bodies.
- REUSE `readRecordObservations({recordsDir})` from brain/scripts/memory/lib/store.mjs — the existing records reader (never throws, skips corrupt lines). Do not write a second JSONL parser.
- Base-branch mechanism ALREADY EXISTS: `config?.project?.defaultBranch ?? 'main'` (brain-ship.mjs:157, brain-governance-status.mjs:59/106/265) + `--base` flag (ticket-start.mjs:30). BUT `project.defaultBranch` is UNSET in brain.config.json and absent from core/config-migrations.mjs defaults → every consumer silently falls back to `main`, which is WRONG on this repo (real base feature/v2.0.0).
- BLOCKER surfaced: session-start.mjs's `assertLocalArgv` allowlist is `GIT_ALLOWED_SUBCOMMANDS = {status, restore, rev-parse}`. `git diff`/`merge-base`/`ls-files` are NOT allowed — bootstrap integration REQUIRES widening that gate by exactly 3 read-only verbs. Isolated into its own PR slice so the gate diff is reviewed on merit.
- session-start.test.mjs statically asserts session-start.mjs's IMPORT GRAPH — adding an import requires updating that guard deliberately.
- Two core anti-patterns are BINDING: `git-diff-no-ve-untracked.md` (must add `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` — diff never sees new files) and `evidence-reader-empty-on-failure.md` (changeset resolver must return value-or-null, never [] on failure).
- brain/project/anti-patterns/ contains ONLY README.md — all real anti-patterns live in brain/core/anti-patterns/ (the unfiltered floor).
- Budget: tests are FREE (`**/*.test.mjs` ∈ governance.ignoreList), as is `openspec/changes/**`. Only production lines count against 400.
- managed-paths.mjs needs NO edit — `brain/scripts/**` (line 41) already covers new scripts.
- i18n/coverage.test.mjs enforces en/es key parity — new keys must go in BOTH catalogs.
- Estimate ~395–430 production lines → HIGH risk → 2 chained PRs: S1 compiler (~345), S2 bootstrap integration + gate widening (~50).
